newsitem.title: UK: EMAP MD Arculus joining United News.
newsitem.headline: EMAP MD Arculus joining United News.

text.p: British media group EMAP Plc said on Monday that managing director David Arculus was leaving the company to join United News & Media.
Arculus, 50, who joined EMAP in 1972, will move to United News on April 7 as chief operating officer.
EMAP, which produces consumer magazines and trade newspapers and operates a number of radio stations, suffered a damaging boardroom split last year when two rebel non-executive directors were ousted.
There was talk at that time of a rift between Arculus and EMAP chief executive Robin Miller.
"We are sad to see David go, but recognise the appeal of UN, which includes mainstream television and newspapers - areas in which EMAP does not operate," said EMAP chairman Sir John Hoskyns.
United News & Media publishes British daily newspapers The Express and Daily Star and also operates commercial television franchises in southern and eastern England.
